newsitem.title: INDIA: India's RBI sets 4.15 pct cut-off at repo auction.
newsitem.headline: India's RBI sets 4.15 pct cut-off at repo auction.

text.p: India's central bank said it had set a cut-off interest rate of 4.15 percent at Thursday's four-day repo auction.
The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said the cut-off at the earlier auction on June 2 was 4.22 percent. The next repo auction is set for June 9.
The RBI said it had received 29 bids amounting to 37.1 billion rupees. The weighted average cut-off rate was 3.4766 percent, it said.
